Subject: Supplier onboarding: ethics intake + PO activation for BlueRidge Logistics

Hi Sanjay / BlueRidge procurement team,

Thanks again for agreeing to partner with Redwood. To get your account set up in our procurement system and enable PO issuance for the first SaaS invoice, please complete the attached onboarding package and return the items below: 

- Completed Redwood Supplier Onboarding Form (attached PDF)
- Supplier diversity / sustainability questionnaire (we accept your XLS or a signed Code of Conduct)
- Remittance details + preferred invoice email (PDF or PDF excerpt)
- Tax status: W-9 (US) or W-8BEN / foreign entity tax docs if applicable
- Certificate of insurance (COI) and vendor contact for security/compliance follow-up

PO activation notes (timeline):
1) Submit completed onboarding docs → Procurement intake (1 business day)
2) Compliance review (COI, Code of Conduct, sustainability self-attestation) → Legal/proc (2–3 business days)
3) PO created and sent to vendor (same-day after approval)

If you can return the files before EOD Wednesday (PST) we can target issuing the first PO by next Monday. Also happy to do a quick 20-minute kickoff call to walk through any items — propose Thu 11/20 10:00–10:30am PT or Fri 11/21 9:00–9:30am PT.

I've attached our Supplier Onboarding Form and a short PO activation checklist. Please let me know if any of the items are a blocker.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Sanjay — good questions. Short answers below and next steps.

- Modern slavery / Code of Conduct: For initial onboarding a signed Supplier Code of Conduct and a self-attestation in your sustainability workbook is acceptable. If we see red flags during the compliance review, legal may request third-party evidence, but that’s not the default.
- Tax docs: For Singapore HQ, please provide your Singapore tax residency certificate (or equivalent) plus your local GST registration. Our AP team will follow up for any withholding considerations.

Next steps I will trigger from our side:
- I’ve uploaded your XLS to the intake queue and flagged it for a standard sustainability review.
- Please complete the Onboarding Form and return (or sign via DocuSign): https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/docuSign/BLR-2025-11
- Send remittance details (PDF) and an invoice sample if available.

Call confirmed: Thu 11/20 10:00–10:30am PT — calendar invite incoming.

Thanks,
Rachel

——Quoted attachments: BLR_Sustainability_Q2.xlsx——

Rachel — a couple notes for the compliance queue before the call: 
- BlueRidge's Singapore domicile means we need to collect either the Certificate of Residence or a Form IRAS equivalent; AP will mark them as "foreign vendor" for tax handling.
- Please ask for a COI with Redwood listed as certificate holder (standard limits).
- If they cannot produce a third-party audit for sustainability, the self-attestation + signed Code of Conduct is fine; flag it for quarterly follow-up.

I will join the Thu call and can run through the COI/tax checklist.

Thanks — Monica
